Done. Summary:

- `out/T3/solution.py`: loads all 114 input tensors via `safetensors.safe_open`, casts exactly the 112 per-layer projection matrices (regex on `model.layers.<i>.(self_attn.{q,k,v,o}_proj|mlp.{gate,up,down}_proj).weight`) to bfloat16, keeps everything else float32 with bit-identical values (verified with `torch.equal`), asserts all four required checks before writing, then bin-packs tensors into shards capped at 256 MiB of tensor data (oversized tensors — `embed_tokens`/`lm_head`, 412 MB each — get their own shard), and writes `model.safetensors.index.json`.
- Ran it once with the sandbox's local `.venv`; it succeeded on the first execution, producing 10 shards, 114 tensors total, verified: 112 bfloat16 + 2 float32, all non-oversized shards exactly at 268,435,456 bytes.
- `out/T3/REPORT.md` written per the template.
